notes: Primary bounds are one-sided paired Student-t bounds over worlds; world-level differences need not be Gaussian, so coverage is a finite-sample approximation.
Contrasts are named first-minus-second in lower-is-better scores: negative favours the first; descriptive 95% t intervals, no claims.
The decomposition is in signal loss L only; reconstruction is diagnosed through L and projected noise, never by substituting E.
oracle_structural_phase_cca_all is a structural-phase reference, not a ceiling; the finite-sample L ceiling is the minimum over the eight all-n fits.

note: development is for implementation and correctness only; no threshold here is a gate
